description: Exact counterexample to universal divisibility by the union of all prime-deletion banks; not a counterexample to Erdos problem 708 or to its minimal-counterexample weighted target.
base_source_set: Every composite integer s with 4 <= s <= base_maximum
lifted_source_set: A = {lifting_prime * s : s is a base source}
interval_definition: I = {p*(C-H-1)+1, ..., p*(C+H)}, where p=lifting_prime and C is the least nonnegative CRT solution below
